simulator: training RM (mean seeds 0,1) prediction appended as the generated track's listened ratio
reward: sum over steps of training RM predictions; REINFORCE with reward-to-go and batch-mean baseline per step
kl: exact KL to the reference on every step, repeats masked in both; -beta*KL enters the reward-to-go and the current-step KL also gets its exact gradient
scope: exploratory, selection window already used; final test untouched; fixed last step reported
